- **Purpose**: PatchMaster is a macOS SwiftUI app with a privileged Swift daemon that discovers and installs app updates for end users.
- **Main surfaces**: The app boots from [PatchMaster/PatchMasterApp.swift](PatchMaster/PatchMasterApp.swift) into [PatchMaster/ContentView.swift](PatchMaster/ContentView.swift) using [PatchMaster/UpdateViewModel.swift](PatchMaster/UpdateViewModel.swift) to drive UI state.
- **IPC model**: App talks to daemon via JSON files in `/tmp/patchmaster-ipc/{requests,responses,progress}` set to 0777. Requests/responses are `DaemonRequest`/`DaemonResponse` objects with a UUID `id` ([PatchMaster/DaemonCommunicator.swift](PatchMaster/DaemonCommunicator.swift), [PatchMasterDaemon/main.swift](PatchMasterDaemon/main.swift)).
- **Supported request types**: `scanApps`, `checkUpdates`, `installApp`, `downloadApp`, `cancelDownload`, `installNativeApp` must be kept in sync between the app and daemon enums (same file links as above).
- **Request timeouts (app side)**: checkUpdates 120s, scanApps 60s, installNativeApp 300s, installApp 600s, downloadApp 900s, cancelDownload 10s ([PatchMaster/DaemonCommunicator.swift](PatchMaster/DaemonCommunicator.swift#L32-L67)).
- **Update discovery order (daemon)**: scans installed apps, then checks native updaters, Sparkle feeds, then Homebrew catalog; skips Office, Apple apps, and legacy exclusions ([PatchMasterDaemon/UpdateChecker.swift](PatchMasterDaemon/UpdateChecker.swift)).
- **Installed app scanning**: Aggressively clears Launch Services and Spotlight caches, walks common app folders (including subdirs and Setapp), deduplicates by bundleId, and normalizes version strings with bundle/short version fallbacks ([PatchMasterDaemon/AppScanner.swift](PatchMasterDaemon/AppScanner.swift)).
- **Native updates**: Registry-driven; currently Parallels Desktop only with `prlctl` commands for check/install, parsed output, and version compare guardrails ([PatchMasterDaemon/NativeUpdateChecker.swift](PatchMasterDaemon/NativeUpdateChecker.swift)).
- **Sparkle updates**: Reads `SUFeedURL` from app Info.plist, parses RSS, and reports when `VersionCompare.isNewer` succeeds ([PatchMasterDaemon/SparkleUpdateChecker.swift](PatchMasterDaemon/SparkleUpdateChecker.swift)).
- **Homebrew updates**: Pulls the cask catalog, caches for 5 minutes, matches by bundleId/name/variations/fuzzy rules, and uses curated bundleId mappings ([PatchMasterDaemon/HomebrewChecker.swift](PatchMasterDaemon/HomebrewChecker.swift)).
- **Version comparisons**: Centralized in [PatchMasterDaemon/VersionCompare.swift](PatchMasterDaemon/VersionCompare.swift); cleans build metadata, handles prefix equivalence, and applies custom heuristics. Reuse it instead of ad-hoc string compares.
- **Download/Install pipeline**: `downloadApp` writes progress JSON per request in `/tmp/patchmaster-ipc/progress/{id}.json`; `DownloadManager` can peel real URLs out of Sparkle XML and renames temp files with inferred extensions ([PatchMasterDaemon/DownloadManager.swift](PatchMasterDaemon/DownloadManager.swift)).
- **Installation rules (daemon)**: Requires root. `AppInstaller` supports dmg/pkg/zip, kills running processes, force-copies to `/Applications`, removes quarantine, fixes ownership/perms, refreshes system caches, and cleans temp mounts ([PatchMasterDaemon/AppInstaller.swift](PatchMasterDaemon/AppInstaller.swift)).
- **UI install flow**: `ContentView` rows call `DaemonCommunicator.downloadAndInstallAppWithResult` or `installNativeAppWithResult`, update progress from the progress files, and auto-refresh app list after a 15s wait ([PatchMaster/ContentView.swift](PatchMaster/ContentView.swift), [PatchMaster/UpdateViewModel.swift](PatchMaster/UpdateViewModel.swift)).
- **Progress scaling**: UI scales reported progress to 5%–80% during download, bumps to 90% pre-install, and completes at 100% after install (see `monitorDownloadProgress` in [PatchMaster/DaemonCommunicator.swift](PatchMaster/DaemonCommunicator.swift)).
- **Daemon lifecycle**: `main.swift` boots IPC dirs (chmod 777), monitors request folder every second, responds with JSON, chmods responses to 666, and leaves the runloop alive ([PatchMasterDaemon/main.swift](PatchMasterDaemon/main.swift)).
- **Packaging/deployment**: `package/scripts/preinstall` stops running instances and unloads the LaunchDaemon; `package/scripts/postinstall` copies the built daemon and plist from the app bundle into `/Library/PrivilegedHelperTools` and `/Library/LaunchDaemons`, sets perms, recreates IPC dirs, and loads the daemon.
- **App bundle expectations**: Postinstall script assumes `PatchMaster.app/Contents/Resources/Daemon/PatchMasterDaemon` and `.../LaunchDaemons/com.mavericklabs.patchmaster.daemon.plist` exist; keep these paths stable when changing packaging.
- **Error/edge handling**: `ContentView` maps common download/install errors to user-friendly messages and provides cancel/retry; daemon logs verbose skip reasons and version checks to aid troubleshooting (see UpdateChecker and ContentView error helpers).
- **When adding new request types**: Update both `DaemonRequest.RequestType` enums, handle the case in `processRequest`, and ensure the app-side timeout fits the expected duration; keep file-based IPC schema stable.
- **Testing**: No automated tests are present; manual validation involves running the app, ensuring `/tmp/patchmaster-ipc` permissions are 777, and confirming the LaunchDaemon is loaded.
